The payout of the supplementary pension in Belgium is linked to retirement, that is, the start date of the statutory pension. The FSMA considers that where the Belgian pension rights are transferred to the EU pension scheme, the start date of the European pension can be considered as retirement, which gives rise to the payout of the supplementary pension.
